notes.title: Wander Stars 1.2.2 patch notes (09/22/2025)
notes.content:
[p]Hello wanderers, we hope you’re enjoying your adventure so far! We’ve received quite a few bug reports since launch so we would like to thank all of you for sharing your feedback, and for being so understanding and patient with us while we sort out these issues. Below is a list of the things that have been fixed for the latest patch:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in which Pep Ups bonus words would refuse to be removed even after using the clear button or closing and reopening the game. This also seemed to affect normal words from time to time. This solution is temporary and remains under observation, some remaining issues may continue. Please let us know if you find any additional problems related to word equipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the words menu with mouse input in which word text color would stay white, even after being clicked and equipped. This issue was not present with controller input.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to one shot the final boss in one turn without blocking progress. This also created an additional issue where player words would disappear after adding them to the slots array.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu buttons have been adjusted to avoid confusion. \[MAIN MENU] is now \[SAVE & QUIT] and \[END EPISODE] has been moved down and changed to \[ABANDON RUN].[/p][/*][*][p]The charge mechanic can only be used with attack actions now.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock in the tutorial battle caused by pressing the end turn button and closing the pause menu at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock that happens when defeating a boss while being hurt by the burn status effect with low HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock in the items/discard menu when using a healing item while already having full HP. It is no longer possible to use healing items at full HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in \[EP5] in which getting caught by guards for not making them fall asleep would duplicate Ringo’s map sprite after returning to the map. This issue had the potential of corrupting save files if the game was forcefully closed while it was saving when this occurred. If anybody else has any issues with their save files because of this or for any other reason, reach out to us at [url="https://hello@papercastlegames.com"]hello@papercastlegames.com[/url] and we’ll restore it for you. [/p][/*][*][p]Decreasing the frame rate in the settings menu would cause Treasure Get buttons to never spawn. This has been fixed and tested with all other available frame rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some cutout elements while playing on Steam Deck native resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]We decided to prioritize issues that were affecting normal play and softlocks. We still have more things we want to fix, but we wanted to upload a patch as soon as possible to fix the most pressing issues so you can keep enjoying your adventure with as few hiccups as possible. [/p][p]
[/p][p]That’s all for now, see you next time on Wander Stars![/p][p]
[/p][p]Paper Castle Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Wander Stars Demo 1.2.1 patch notes (9/14/25)
notes.content:
[p]It’s almost time for the full release tomorrow![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/3529c88608d0d9c3621002afbfff9933711d7964.png"][/img][/p][p]We decided to update the demo to be closer to the final quality of the full game. There are [i]a lot[/i] of bug fixes, UI adjustments, and quality of life improvements. Since it’s too much to count everything, here’s a more general list:  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]UI sound effects levels have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller input UI fixes like being able to remove one word at a time instead of clearing all words. No need to redo all your word selection anymore! You can now hold down the B button to clear all.[/p][/*][*][p]Open and close boss zones with the left joystick button is now possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of words, they can now be added and replaced regardless of slot size. So if you have a small action word you can instantly replace it with a medium or big word, regardless of MOD/ELE words in the action array.[/p][/*][*][p]Pep ups menu has been improved, not only the UX but also a lot of exploits related to bonus words not equipping correctly or even affecting cooldowns for other words.[/p][/*][*][p]Pep ups affecting equipment limits incorrectly has also been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The story script has been revised and improved in some areas.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to freely change display resolution and display mode. Included for Steam Deck resolutions as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller input stopped being weird in the items menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Ringo no longer shouts twice for every attack, she was getting a bit hoarse.[/p][/*][*][p]Honor points are not being multiplied by two when transitioning from episode end results and episode select menu.[/p][/*][*][p]And so much more.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]We hope to see you tomorrow for the big day![/p][p] [/p][p]Paper Castle Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Wander Stars Release Date Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/00a29f6b241b3a929d0d942f9b60600799aef587.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone, we have some news to share.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wander Stars is coming out a little bit later[/b] than you might have expected. [/p][p][/p][p]First of all, we want to thank you for participating in the open beta. We truly value every bit of feedback and ideas that you have shared with us, but it has also made it very clear that we need more time to truly deliver the game we wanted to make from the start. [/p][p][/p][p][b]We heard you loud and clear[/b] – the UI is broken in many places and often confusing. The combat bugs can ruin the fun, and the balancing is a bit wacky starting from episode 2 onwards.[/p][p][/p][p]So based on your feedback, [b]we have decided to take a bit more time[/b] to polish, balance, and take care of the bugs currently hindering the game. We’ve also been working on overdrive to meet our previous deadline, so taking a bit more time will not only make the game better overall, but it is also necessary for us to take care of our wellbeing as we approach the finish line.[/p][p][/p][p]And in an Underhero-like twist of events, Wander Stars is now launching on [b]September 19[/b]. That’s right, on the 7th anniversary of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/573320/Underhero/"]Underhero[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/573320/Underhero/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]That’s a[i] very [/i]long time, and we are truly thankful for your patience with us and for being here all these years. We really think the wait will be worth it, and we can’t wait to share the final and improved version of Wander Stars with all of you.[/p][p]
Lots of love,
Paper Castle Team[/p]

notes.title: Wander Stars Demo 1.1.1 patch notes (6/14/25):
notes.content:
[p]Hi there, we hope you’ve had a wonderful Next Fest![/p][p]
We’ve been reading your feedback and working on some general bug fixes for the demo:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Wolfe would fail to join the party again after a game over.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where using an item would sometimes heal enemies instead of the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock caused by quitting episode 1 and immediately starting over.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock in the treasure/power up menu. It wouldn’t spawn the accept button if you changed resolutions in settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with controllers that would invert enemy targets selection, if there were 3 or more in the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new action total feature, where you can see how much damage your action will inflict if it’s normal, weak, or resist.[/p][/*][*][p]Added letter-boxing for ultra wide resolutions, maintaining the correct aspect ratio of 16:9 the game was designed for.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed undefeated run appearing as 0 in episode end results, when it should display the bonus value.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the SP button spawning a placeholder button icon during tutorials if you used a mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed challenge mode special conditions repeating for all combats in the same map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed challenge mode special condition that inflicts bleed with weaks, now affects all actors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare instance where the dark overlay of the pause menu would remain active after closing the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ringo’s landing animation smoke VFX. The Shader displayed a border around the smoke that looked very weird.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the combat deed “First turn finish”. It would occasionally reward the player with honor even after several turns passed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for today. As always thank you for playing, and please share your feedback so we can improve the game even further!

Paper Castle Team.[/p]

notes.title: Wander Stars Demo 1.0.5 patch notes
notes.content:
Welcome back, wanderers!

Here are the changes and fixes for the newest demo patch:

[list]
[*] Added a fix for a randomly occurring softlock when closing the pause menu. The dark overlay would refuse to leave and wouldn’t let the game continue. Darkness eradicated.
[*] Using rewind (pause/game over menus) in certain conditions wouldn’t recover cooldowns or replenish the player to full HP.
[*] We have now added additional fixes for different ways to trigger this previous bug  “Fixed a softlock fighting a boss where the final hit white VFX would get stuck on screen, rendering the rest of the playthrough unplayable.”
[*] “Softlock happening late in the demo where characters fail to show up in combat.” This issue continues to pop up for some players, and we have attempted more solutions. If you experience this issue again, please let us know with any info you can provide in hopes of tracking down the origin of the problem. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the combat buttons that would change the text of the buttons to placeholder text and render the buttons unusable.
[*] In the previous update we changed the way SP is used. But it was still possible to increase your spirit slots above your limit when words were already placed in any of the slots. It is now fixed.
[*] Trying to add a second elemental word when one was already in a slot, would let you add another word on top of the element. Basically two words would share the same slot. Exploit fixed.
[/list]

This is a game in development, and we encourage any feedback you can give us to improve the game even more!

Please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1575810/discussions/0/4363502351657577339/]Steam general discussions[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/papercastle]discord server[/url] to reach us directly.

notes.title: Wander Stars Demo 1.0.4 patch notes
notes.content:
Hello again, wanderers!

Here are the changes and fixes for the new version:

[list]
[*] Changed the way SP is used in combat. Now it can only recover used spirit slots, instead of granting extra slots for huge attacks too early in the game. You can earn additional slots if you find power ups or train for the permanent slot upgrade in the full game.
[*] Options/pause menu now available for quitting or restarting the episode in the map sections. (Progress is not saved in the demo version).
[*] Combat word box page scrolling is smoother now. 
[*] Combat word box now shows 1/1 page when there are not enough words for two pages.
[*] Fixed a softlock in the tutorial where the end turn button wasn’t usable in one specific instance.
[*] Using a controller and spamming the A button before the first tutorial caused words to not appear.
[*] Fixed a softlock fighting a boss where the final hit white VFX would get stuck on screen, rendering the rest of the playthrough unplayable.
[*] Added another possible fix for a softlock mentioned in the previous patch notes: “softlock happening late in the demo where characters fail to show up in combat.”
[*] Kingjoe enemy now appear with their own names in combat.
[*] Removed “Exclusive Fullscreen” display mode for causing flickering issues.
[*] Fixed a small issue in the “Thanks for playing” screen. There was a timer for enabling clicks and button presses that was not removed when the new wishlist and main menu buttons were added.
[*] Fixed a bug when using the PEACE button while there were words in the spirit slots that interrupted the peace sequence.
[*] Improved treasure get item randomization when receiving more than one item.
[/list]

This is a game in active development, and we´re always looking out for more feedback!

Please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1575810/discussions/0/4363502351657577339/]Steam general discussions[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/papercastle]discord server[/url] to reach us directly.

Paper Castle

notes.title: Get to know the development team behind Wander Stars
notes.content:
We recently announced Paper Castle Games’ word-based RPG, Wander Stars, has joined the Fellow Traveller family! Wander Stars is a turn-based RPG with roguelite elements that follows the adventures of Ringo and Wolfe in this story-driven adventure inspired by 90s anime.

Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.

We asked the Paper Castle team to introduce themselves, talk about the game, their inspirations, game development, and more. Read on, wordsmiths!

[h3]Fellow Traveller (FT): So tell us, who are Paper Castle Games and what is your journey so far?[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/394402e9af52db7dcc4f26d581edf15f5b418ce0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/1afcb898f7775b37636e76f6fa59e89bc4551c33.png[/img][/url]
Heyo I’m Kay (he/him), game designer and artist/animator for Wander Stars. Rafa and I have been childhood friends since preschool. One day while playing a co-op game we had the bold idea to make video games together and Paper Castle Games was born!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/f3291c02c0766d3f16f01985d6db53901c382065.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/2787aa22e97bad44e2cea220257b5c0013afb0b3.png[/img][/url]
Hi my name is Rafael (he/him) and I'm the programmer at Paper Castle Games, I'm pretty much your average geek guy that enjoys partaking in Dungeons & Dragons, anime binging and video games.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/031e4e31a826e846370ce3fa5381e8a106be0262.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/0d742950675b3e58e21cd6ff5614988d5e94fb67.png[/img][/url]
Hey there! I’m Andie (she/they), the lead writer and background artist for Wander Stars. I was the last member to officially join the team but I’ve been helping Kay and Rafa out since the early days of Paper Castle around 2013.

[h3]FT: What is Wander Stars, and how is development going?[/h3]

Kay: Wander Stars is a turn-based RPG with roguelite elements where you make your own attacks by combining words. We came up with this unique mechanic for “word-building” attacks and immediately associated it with the anime shows we grew up with like Dragon Ball and Sailor Moon, where the characters call out the names of their attacks.

Development has been going well! A bit bumpy at first but I think we’ve found our footing, and we’re happy to say we just recently passed the halfway point in terms of content for the game, so we’re technically halfway there.

[h3]FT: Wander Stars is obviously inspired by 90s anime. Which of those shows are your faves?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/08f25b1fb370f4bae074f53b50fa2c308dbaf965.gif[/img]

Rafael: From the 90s and a bit before I'd have to say Dragon Ball Z, Rurouni Kenshin and Evangelion were my favorites growing up.

Andie: Sailor Moon and Cardcaptor Sakura were my favorites as a kid! I grew up watching these shows and they have remained a huge influence in my work.

Kay: We all watched the same shows while growing up, and I love the ones already mentioned, so other standouts for me were Cowboy Bebop and OG Dragon Ball which is actually from the 80’s!

[h3]FT: If each run-through of the game is like an episode, are players eventually able to play a ‘finale’ to wrap up the show?[/h3]

Andie: Yes, absolutely. The story of Wander Stars was written like an animated show with character arcs, story arcs, and a serialized narrative that advances the plot with each episode.

And after the finale, who knows? Even though the story of the game wraps up by the last episode, we have left some open-ended plot points that could follow the cast into future adventures.

[h3]FT: It looks like there is a diverse cast of characters for players to meet: do you have any standouts or favorites yet?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409318/5954a952a4ce7cb5c2a36411d9676c6d27b0297d.png[/img]

Rafael: I have a particular fondness for the gray boxer crabs since they were our first fully completed enemy and I've seen them for a few years now testing game mechanics.

Andie: Personally I have a lot of fun writing Wolfe and getting inside his headspace. He’s very mysterious at the start of the game and he’s a good balance to Ringo’s headstrong personality, so it’s really funny to see him try to keep a cool head and make sense out of all the weird situations Ringo pulls him into.

Kay: I think I’ll go with the character that kick-started this whole thing: Ringo, the young martial artist with the apple head. She was the first character to be designed so everything else emerged around her. My favorite detail about her is the way her hair is half classic shonen protagonist (pure black) and the other half is magical girl (shiny and colorful).

[h3]FT: And that’s a wrap! Thank you for talking about Wander Stars and sharing your journey with us![/h3]

To stay up to date with all things Wander Stars and the team at Paper Castle Games, visit the [b][url=https://papercastlegames.com/wanderstars/][b]website[/b][/url],[/b] follow [b][url=https://twitter.com/papercastledevs]Paper Castle Games [/url][/b]and [b][url=https://twitter.com/FellowTravellr]us [/url][/b]on Twitter or join in the discussion on the [url=https://discord.gg/sk89hQj57x][b]Fellow Traveller Discord server[/b][/url].

notes.title: Development update 2022
notes.content:
Hi there! 

It’s been a year since we announced our Kickstarter campaign for Wander Stars. A lot of things have changed since then, but the most important thing is that we signed a publishing deal for Wander Stars! That’s why we have decided to postpone the Kickstarter indefinitely. The game is still early in development but everything is going well, and now that our financial needs are covered we just want to focus on making the best game we can. 

If you still want to support development, make sure to wishlist and follow Wander Stars here on Steam if you haven’t already! 

If you have any questions, you can find us at our [url= https://discord.gg/papercastle]discord server.[/url]⭐️

Lots of love,
Paper Castle
